row.evidence: Gainsight's SCIM API article documents a SCIM base URL (https://<<tenant-url>>/v1/users/services/scim), while every Gainsight Customer Success plan on the pricing page (Essentials, Enterprise) is 'Request Pricing'.
row.notes: Gainsight CS has no self-serve or listed price: Essentials and Enterprise both say 'Request Pricing', so SCIM can only be bought through sales; no first-party page says which plan includes SCIM. June values dropped for lack of a first-party source: scim_plan 'Enterprise', the ~$150 and ~$300/u/mo figures (third-party), and 'SCIM requires SAML SSO'. SCIM shipped in the July 2025 CS release as an 'Automatic Update'; the SCIM docs return 401 when 'the SCIM feature was not enabled'. Okta setup uses a custom SAML+SCIM app (no Gainsight CS app in OIN; only Gainsight PX is listed). Entra gallery app is SSO-only. Deprovisioning sets active=false and removes the license. Status kept at gated on the Contact Sales rule, at low confidence.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Gainsight Customer Success plan; 10 included full users.

auth.token_source: Gainsight M2M OAuth client ID/secret (POST /v1/users/m2m/oauth/token) or an OAuth app created in Gainsight
auth.token_expiry: 86400 seconds (24 hours) per sample token response

operations.notes: Docs show POST/GET/PUT/PATCH on /Users and POST/GET/PUT/PATCH on /Groups; no DELETE operation is documented for users or groups. Group PUT changes displayName only.

deprovision.data_retained: User record stays as inactive; permission bundle, license type and login credentials are removed.

pagination.notes: startIndex/count; default count is 100, no maximum stated.

custom.how: urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:gainsight:2.0:User namespace (IsSuperAdmin, LicenseType, custom_roles, plus Boolean/String/Picklist/Multi-Picklist custom fields); mappings must be pre-configured by Gainsight Support.

attributes.notes: Default mapping table marks nickName, preferredLanguage, profileUrl, userType, phoneNumbers, password, ims, photos, addresses, entitlements and x509Certificates as Not Supporting.

roles.how: SCIM roles attribute (mapped to roles_gc), custom_roles and IsSuperAdmin in the Gainsight extension; LicenseType sets the license; SCIM user groups can apply Super Admin/License Type to members.

rate_limits.text: Overall recommended limit: 100 synchronous API calls per minute / 100,000 per day.

limitations.text: Create, update and PATCH calls require a super admin; GET is available to non-super admins.
Custom attribute mappings must be pre-configured by Gainsight Support before use.
Roles and groups must always be sent on PUT; groups sent in PATCH replace all existing groups.
Many core SCIM attributes (phoneNumbers, addresses, preferredLanguage, entitlements and others) are not supported.
401 is returned when the SCIM feature is not enabled for the tenant, implying per-tenant enablement.

rate_limits.text: External User Management APIs: 100 requests per hour / 1000 requests per day.

limitations.text: Super admin field cannot be created or updated through the User Management APIs.

okta.notes: OIN search for 'gainsight' returns only GainsightPX (a separate product). Gainsight's Okta guide builds a custom SAML 2.0 app with SCIM provisioning against the generic endpoint.

entra.notes: Gallery app 'Gainsight SAML' tutorial covers SSO only; the SCIM docs mention M2M OAuth is ideal for systems like Azure (c38).

google.notes: Gainsight supports G Suite authentication; no Google catalogue provisioning app found.

fallbacks.other_sync: Add users from external systems (Salesforce, Dynamics, Zendesk, HubSpot, Slack)

open_questions: Which Gainsight CS plan (Essentials or Enterprise) includes SCIM is not stated on any first-party page.
Whether SAML SSO is plan-gated is not stated (Entra tutorial requires an 'SSO enabled subscription').
Whether SAML sign-in creates users just-in-time is not documented.
No SCIM DELETE operation, ServiceProviderConfig, Schemas or Bulk endpoints are documented.
Whether SCIM deactivation ends active sessions is not documented.
Plan required for the User Management REST API is not stated.
No audit-log API or user-event webhooks found.
JumpCloud and OneLogin catalogue pages could not be checked (403 / bot challenge).
